units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 15:11">Targ. O. Ex. XV, 11</cite> <he>לית אִ׳ את</he> none but thou, none besides thee; a. e.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 5:1">Ber. V, 1</cite> <he>אין עומדין … א׳ וכ׳</he> one must stand up for prayer in no other disposition but that of humility.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 4a">Snh. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>לא נתן א׳ שלשה</he> he did only three times.
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 1:1">Ber. I, 1</cite> <he>ולא זו בלבד</he> (<he>אמרו</he>) <he>א׳ וכ׳</he> and not only in this case they said so, but wherever &c.
Ib. 5ᵃ אל תקרי תְלַמְּדֶנּוּ א׳ תְלַמְּדֵנוּ read not th’lamm’dennu (thou instructest him) but th’lamm’dēnu (thou teachest us); a. v. fr.

senses.gloss: (ellipt.) (you cannot say anything except …) but, a logical inference excluding all other explanations &c. Ib. 30ᵇ א׳ לא שנא but (the conclusion is proven) there is no difference. Ib. א׳ אמר ר׳ but, said R. … we may derive it &c.; a. fr.
